# vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp

## Overview

[`vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp#L864-L905) registers protected SSBO read, write, and atomic roots. The canonical tree below documents `ssbo_read`; `ssbo_write` has the same direct children and `ssbo_atomic` first splits by shader stage.

## Role

Implementation file that registers tests.

## Source Code

- Primary source: [`vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp#L1)

## Registration Hierarchy

```text
protected_memory.ssbo.ssbo_read
├── default
└── protected_access
```

## Test Families

### default — Default pipeline-protection setup
[`default`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp#L734-L763) is generated by the `protectedAccess` table.

### protected_access — Pipeline protected access setup
[`protected_access`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp#L734-L763) is excluded from Vulkan SC builds and enables pipeline-protected-access handling.

## Parameter Dimensions

`ssbo_read` and `ssbo_write` use default/protected-access groups, pipeline flag groups, fragment/compute shader groups, and static/random leaves at [`vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp#L752-L787). `ssbo_atomic` is registered at [`vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp#L884-L905) and covers eight atomic operations listed at [`vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp#L898-L899).

## Support / Feature Requirements

[`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp#L232-L235) uses protected-context support and requests pipeline-protected access when requested. Nonzero protected-access pipeline flags are skipped for the default protected-access entry at [`vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp#L764-L768).

## Verification Methods

Fragment and compute execution paths validate buffers with [`validateBuffer()`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp#L560-L564) and [`validateBuffer()`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemStorageBufferTests.cpp#L671-L675).

## Test Principles Observed

- The file combines shader stage, protection mode, pipeline flags, static/random data, and atomic operation dimensions.
- Vulkan SC guards remove protected-access-specific groups and flags from the generated tree.
